subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey on `workboard create` CLI and `workboard_create` agent tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a public optional session-key input to both Workboard card-creation interfaces, rather than keeping session association in existing Workboard workflows?
rationale: This is a requested capability rather than a verified break in an established contract, and the current implementation, supported alternatives, and feature ownership could not be inspected in the blocked environment.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded Workboard feature
options.body: Confirm the existing owner boundary and add the optional input consistently to the supported creation interfaces.

options.title: Retain existing session-association flows
options.body: Keep session linking in the current UI or dispatch workflow if that is the intended product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded Workboard feature
recommendation.body: Confirm the existing owner boundary and add the optional input consistently to the supported creation interfaces.
